title: VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills — Cross-Platform Agent Skill Repository
description: Curated repository of 1000+ agent skills compatible across Claude Code, Codex (OpenAI), Gemini CLI, Cursor, and other coding agents. Includes official dev team skills and community contributions. An MCP server auto-fetches and updates skills from the repository. Cross-platform compatibility is the key differentiator — skills work across model providers.
redundancy_check: Our skill system is entirely workspace-specific (20+ skills in ~/.claude/skills/). This repository offers community-validated, cross-platform skills. Cross-platform compatibility is novel — not covered by existing skill infrastructure. Distinct from awesome-claude-code-subagents (agents vs skills).
research_questions: How much overlap exists with our existing 20+ skills?
Which skills in this repo address capability gaps we currently lack?
Is cross-platform compatibility (Codex/Gemini CLI) a priority for this workspace?
What does the MCP auto-fetch server look like — is it safe to install?
Are there specific skills in this repo better than our existing equivalents?

evaluation.reasoning: Cross-platform skill compatibility is novel but of limited value for this workspace (we don't actively use Codex CLI or Gemini CLI as skill targets). The MCP auto-fetch server safety is unverified. Overlap with existing 20+ skills unknown — could be mostly redundant. Research priority: compare with antigravity-awesome-skills-installer (both in pending) and pick the stronger of the two. Do not adopt both. Key question: does either offer skills that fill genuine capability gaps not covered by workspace-specific skills?
